description: List the available compliance tests in the regulatory catalogue (e.g., GDPR consent capture, EU AI Act disclosure, PCI-DSS DTMF masking). Each entry has an ID + sector + description. Use the IDs as input to runComplianceTest.

sector.description: Sector filter (e.g. `financial-services`). Omit to receive all sectors.

name: listComplianceCatalogue

outputSchema.description:
Response for `GET /testing/compliance-catalogue`. Single round-trip carries the filtered
catalogue plus the workspace's per-tier picker cap, available s2stest seconds, and tier
— everything the picker UI needs.

catalogue.description:
Bundled compliance catalogue. Filtered server-side to the workspace's sector
(`all` always included; other sectors only when the query string `sector` matches).
Deprecated tests are stripped.

additionalProperties.description: One regulation entry from the compliance catalogue.

jurisdiction.description: Free-form jurisdiction (e.g. `uk`, `eu`, `uk+eu`, `global`, `us`, or a US state as `us-ca`; several states join with `+`).

items.description:
Compliance catalogue test entry. Each test exercises one regulatory scenario; an
agent calls the IVR with `mission`, and the LLM judge evaluates `pass`/`fail`.
Mapping from a compliance test to clauses it covers in a named regulation.

probes.description:
What the simulated customer says, in order. Present on every test
applicable to a text channel.

Required to dispatch this test over chat. The digital worker drives
the whole transcript from these, so a run without them produces a
one-turn transcript containing only the bot's greeting, and the
judge then scores it against conditions it had no chance to satisfy.
Absent on voice-only tests.
example: What can you help me with?

pickerLimit.description: Maximum number of tests the workspace's tier may dispatch in one batch.

s2stestSecondsAvailable.description: Remaining s2stest seconds in the workspace's quota.

title: List Compliance Catalogue
